people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

translations.web: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
translations.bsb: In the letters she wrote: “Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
